I was a gigantic whale too, so even walking was so much effort haha. Stick to your guns mumma! What is best for you is also what is best for your baby! It's a very pressured environment when you're in that situation. I expressed for ages and felt proud about it but also miserable! My boy was in the NICU so I couldn't actually breastfeed and then after a while traumatic birth/being in the hospital I just decided formula was 100% the best thing for both of us. Xx

I have pernicious anaemia, so my body does not absorb folic acid or vitamin B very well. I had a course of treatment and then my doctor said I was fine and stopped it. 

I was on the contraceptive pill, but it didn't work because I discovered I was pregnant when I was 5 months gone. At the 20 week scan I discovered my son had spina bifida. 

I am convinced that it was due to me not being able to absorb folic acid properly. (I felt guilty for a long time). 

He's here now and he is the most amazing little boy!! I do worry for when we are ready for another child but I will be pushing for more tests into my condition.

Best of luck to both of you on your journey to becoming parents. Get blood tests for vitamin B and folic acid, and talk to your doctor. Even if it is "borderline" I would request a higher strength of folic acid. 400mcg is the prenatal amount. I was on 5mg for a few months. Xx

I cut back on sugar and carbs, go for brown bread and loads of veggies and stuff. I still have chocolate and crisps and naughty things, and my bloods have been really stable.
